title: StaffMode Plus
description: A way for staff to seperate their admin account from their personal survival account
body:
Want your staff to be able to modderate your server while still playing on the server themselves? This mod adds /staffmode command to put your staff into a staffmode, it puts them in creative mode and gives them their staff inventory. When they switch back they get teleported back and recieve their survival invetory back! 

In the config you can set a role that staff in staffmode will get via luckperms, using this role you can give them access to commands like tp, gamemode, invsee, ... that they need to moderate the server but just give them permanent access to _staffmode.staffmode.toggle_ to be able to switch between the 2 modes

Also includes /staffmode vanish to go completely invisible! You will still be shown on the tablist but no player can see you(even with hacked clients)
